verdict.rationale: Fivetran ships an official MCP server that lets users run natural-language queries against their account, such as whether a connection's last sync succeeded or whether any connections are broken, and write/delete operations can be enabled via scope. It also provides first-party coding-agent plugins for building, testing and deploying Connector SDK connectors with natural-language prompts. Natural-language operation depends on an external AI client, is read-only by default, and there is no evidence of a native natural-language command interface in the product itself. missing for 10: native in-product natural-language command console, documented natural-language coverage of full pipeline operations (create/configure/sync), independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: It allows you to ask read-only questions like "when was the last time my postgres connection completed a sync?" and "are any of my connections broken?"
Set `FIVETRAN_SCOPE` to `read/write` or `read/write/delete` to unlock write and delete operations
These skills let you build, test, and deploy connectors using natural language prompts.
